## Peer-Reviewed Research
- Title: Automated Edge Vision & Retail Checkout System using Quantized YOLOv5 on Embedded Hardware
- Publisher: IEEE Xplore | Document ID: 10627276
- Technical Method: INT8 Post-Training Quantization via ONNX Runtime on Raspberry Pi (<1% mAP degradation, sub-second inference)
- Invariant Note: Uses Raspberry Pi and YOLOv5; does NOT use Arduino or RFID.
